findings.title: AAI_ReturnTo_Cover_Tip says "best cover nearby", but vanilla stops at the pawn's own cell once it is good enough
findings.detail: TryFindCoverCell calls CastPositionFinder.TryFindCastPosition, which scores the caster's own cell first and returns it at once if its preference is >= 1.0, without looking at nearby cells. A pawn on a good-enough spot stays even when a better covered cell is within 6 tiles, and the score also weighs range and the avoid grid, not just cover. Change the sentence in Languages/English/Keyed/AbilityAI.xml:31 to something like "It stays put if its own spot already has good cover.", which matches the code comment at AbilityAI.cs:993 ("a pawn that cast from good cover stays").
